item.title: What Inflation Reports Actually Mean for Your Budget
item.description: The monthly CPI report gets a headline number, but that number isn't your grocery bill. Here's how to read an inflation report and what to actually change in your budget because of it.

item.title: What Fed Rate Decisions Actually Mean for Your Wallet
item.description: Every Fed announcement gets headlines, but few explain what it changes for your mortgage, savings, and credit cards. Here's the plain-language version.
